sources.publication_semantics: EDGAR submissions and XBRL APIs update as filings are disseminated; individual facts carry filing/accession metadata but aggregate Company Facts must be reconstructed by filing/accession to preserve first-known values.
source_quality_notes: No authentication/API key required for data.sec.gov.
Current aggregate Company Facts must not be treated as a ready-made PIT panel.
8A validator must key facts by accession/filed timestamp and distinguish later amendments/restatements before this source can become SAFE for a research dataset.

sources.publication_semantics: Submission history is disseminated by EDGAR and can be anchored no earlier than the public filing acceptance/dissemination time. Event meaning still requires a separate deterministic extractor and source hierarchy.
source_quality_notes: SAFE refers only to the filing/publication timestamp and accession identity, not to any yet-unvalidated event classifier.
A later amended filing must remain a new version and may not overwrite the original event record.

sources.publication_semantics: Official documentation states annual/quarterly EPS and revenue estimates with analyst count and revision history, but does not establish immutable historical as-of snapshots or publication timestamps for each revision observation.
source_quality_notes: Potential low-friction 8B candidate.
Must validate returned field semantics, historical depth, per-observation timestamps, symbol coverage and terms before any backtest.
Current response must never be retrojected to historical scanner dates.

sources.publication_semantics: Earnings-trends responses expose current consensus plus 7/30/60/90-day prior EPS trend values and revision counts. Documentation describes historical records by fiscal period, but the observation/vintage timestamp needed for strict historical as-of reconstruction still requires API-sample validation.
source_quality_notes: Strong 8B candidate because revision deltas are exposed directly.
Do not interpret fiscal-period date as observation timestamp.
Need licensed API sample to prove whether historical rows are immutable vintages or current reconstructed values.

sources.publication_semantics: Provider documents historical estimate/revision feeds with date filters and 20+ years of history; historical access is an Enterprise product/add-on and therefore cannot be assumed available to this project.
source_quality_notes: Best-documented PIT revisions candidate found in initial 8A survey.
Not usable until commercial access, redistribution/internal-use terms, and actual field-level timestamps are confirmed for this project.
SAFE is a source-semantics classification, not a license/access approval.

sources.publication_semantics: Financial Estimates endpoint documents forward consensus by fiscal date. Historical ratings exist separately, but initial documentation review does not establish dated historical EPS/revenue consensus snapshots suitable for strict revision backtesting.
source_quality_notes: Do not use current analyst-estimate rows to reconstruct past consensus.
Historical ratings are not a substitute for historical EPS/revenue estimate vintages.
Can be reconsidered only if a separate timestamped revisions-history endpoint is documented and validated.

sources.publication_semantics: Short interest is reported twice monthly and publicly disseminated later; research valid_from must be the publication date, never the settlement date. FINRA states online/API coverage is rolling five years and corrections can replace prior data with a revision flag.
source_quality_notes: Historical point-in-time use is contaminated if a later correction is retrojected without an archived original release.
Prospective use can be clean if ingested and versioned at each publication date.
Historical files may improve coverage but still require correction-vintage testing.

sources.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
sources.publication_semantics: ALFRED explicitly stores real-time periods/vintage dates so observations can be queried as known on a historical date. Release dates do not necessarily equal API availability, so research must use the real-time period/vintage rather than calendar release date alone.
source_quality_notes: PIT-safe at the data-vintage level.
License/copyright must be checked per underlying series/source before persistent redistribution.
Macro series become evidence only after a versioned security-to-exposure mapping is separately validated.

8A_decision.reason: A revisions source with strict historical as-of semantics has not yet been both technically and economically cleared for this project.
8A_decision.fallback_to_8C_trigger: If Alpha Vantage and EODHD fail field-level PIT validation and Intrinio access is not economically acceptable, move Fundamentals/Structured Corporate Events ahead of 8B as allowed by the Phase-8 plan.
